root: ^Petra: Hello again! Did you need something?

c-0: ^Petra: We look after the trees, water the roots, and keep a record for those who’ll come after us.
^We make sure nature doesn’t get drained dry by folks who don’t care.
^We’ve got a special job from Mithriel herself: guarding the oaks of Slepbone.
^Petra: You know, it’s a huge honor to be called upon by our goddess. When things get tough, it’s that calling that keeps us going and trusting the mission.
c-1: ^Petra: Good question! If you need flowers for potions, don’t worry—royal flowers, dandelions, rosemary, they all come back after a few days.
^We always make sure there’s plenty growing around here.
c-2: ^Petra: That’d be Dorrim, the blacksmith. Lives under this hill.
^Lost his memory a long time ago... but the man can still swing a hammer like no other.
^ Need a weapon or some smithing tips? He’s the right person to ask.
